spine: 1. ZippyDB 的 direct-access 模型讓每個 client 直接連到它要用的每台資料庫主機，fan-in = H_client · p，跟 client 母體數成線性關係。
2. 這個線性關係是系統性風險：client cohort 一多，每台資料庫主機的連線負擔就跟著變差，一次 routing bug 就能把整個機隊撞進 reboot loop。
3. ZGateway 插入一層 stateless proxy，內部跑 Meta 既有的 thick C++ client（一個 use case 一份），透過 ServiceRouter 做 regional 探索與路由，讓每個 client 就近連到自己的 gateway。
4. Gateway 把連線這件事的公式换了：fan-in 不再含 H_client 這一項，變成約等於 R · S_host（region 数 × 每主機 shard 密度）——這是 Meta 自己能控制的變數，不是 client 数。

5. Gateway 同時做四件事把單純「轉發」變成真正省資源：batching/coalescing 把同一 shard 的請求合併成一個 backend RPC、read cache 靠 CDC 做失效、Discriminant Load Shedding 用 per-tenant bucket 隔離 noisy neighbor、adaptive load balancing 依 CPU 動態調權重。
6. 量出來的效果：per-host 連線數降 ~97-98%、總連線数降 ~19x、流量佔比 40% 並預期超過 60%、平均只加 ~6% overhead、DLS 在 >90% CPU 下 1,350 個 bucket 只有 6 個被 shed，goodput 仍維持 97-98%。
7. 誠實的代價：多一跳、多一層要維運；batching 把 request 留在記憶體裡是 OOM 風險，靠 idle eviction 和 in-flight cap 兜底；還有正在規劃、尚未上線的 co-location 想法要進一步壓掉那一跳的開銷。

perspective.mechanism: 在資料庫前插入一層 stateless proxy（ZGateway），把 direct-access 模型裡『資料庫主機 fan-in 隨 client 母體線性成長』的公式，換成『fan-in ≈ region 数 × 每主機 shard 密度，與 client 母體無關』，同時做 TLS 終止、per-tenant admission control、batching/coalescing、CDC 失效的讀取快取、per-tenant bucket 的 Discriminant Load Shedding、依 CPU 動態調權重的 adaptive load balancing，以及三層（global routing／mega-regions／rings）跨區域失效。
perspective.tradeoff: 換掉連線扇入公式的代價是多一跳延遲、多一層要維運的 proxy；batching 把 request 暫留在記憶體裡本身是 OOM 風險，要靠 idle eviction 與 in-flight cap 兩道保險兜住；batcher 與 cache 目前共用一個 process，一個租戶的記憶體炸開可能波及同機所有租戶，這件事要靠規劃中、尚未上線的 multi-process 架構解決；更進一步的 co-location（把部分 gateway 搬到 ZServer 主機旁邊）也還停在計畫階段。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師在自家系統遇到『client 数一多、資料庫連線就爆炸』這類 fan-in 問題時，可以參考這個把『不可控變數（client 母體）』從公式裡拿掉、換成『可控變數（shard/資源密度）』的思路；DLS 的 per-tenant bucket + round-robin 隔離模式，也是多租戶系統做 noisy-neighbor 隔離時可以直接借鏡的具體做法。

notes.quote: every ZippyDB client connects to every database host it needs
notes.interpretation: 定義 direct-access 模型的基本拓樸：全對全連線。

notes.quote: A typical client holds tens of thousands of outbound connections, and a typical database host can accept tens of thousands of inbound ones.
notes.interpretation: 量化 direct 模型下連線負擔的規模。

notes.quote: In the direct model, database-host fan-in is H_client · p — linear in the client population, so every new cohort makes every database host worse.
notes.interpretation: 核心結構性主張：direct 模型下 fan-in 與 client 母體數線性相關。

notes.quote: a routing bug led every client to open a connection per shard, hosts breached their file-descriptor limit, and the fleet fell into a reboot loop.
notes.interpretation: 文中舉出的一次真實事故，說明 fan-in 拓樸的脆弱性。

notes.quote: ZGateway is a stateless proxy tier between ZippyDB clients and the database (ZServer) fleet.
notes.interpretation: ZGateway 的架構定義。

notes.quote: runs our thick C++ client as its engine, one internal client per use case.
notes.interpretation: ZGateway 內部運行 Meta 既有的 thick client，每個 use case 各自一份。

notes.quote: It runs as regional tiers discovered through ServiceRouter, Meta's hyperscale service mesh solution, keeping every client near its gateway.
notes.interpretation: ZGateway 透過 ServiceRouter 做 regional 探索，讓 client 就近連 gateway。

notes.quote: A client sends a request over its sticky connection to a regional ZGateway host, which terminates TLS, authorizes it against the use case's ACLs, and applies per-tenant admission control, validation, and shaping.
notes.interpretation: request 在 ZGateway 端的處理流程：sticky connection、TLS 終止、ACL 授權、admission control。

notes.quote: Per-host connection counts collapse by ~97–98%.
notes.interpretation: 實測的每主機連線數下降比例。

notes.quote: drop by roughly 19x, because each backend connection multiplexes many clients.
notes.interpretation: 總 persistent 連線数下降倍率，原因是後端連線多路復用多個 client。

notes.quote: A shared batcher on each host groups requests headed for the same destination ... merges them into one backend RPC.
notes.interpretation: batching 機制：把同目的地的請求合併成一個 backend RPC。

notes.quote: Thousands of simultaneous callers collapse into a single backend read, so a hot key can never become a stampede.
notes.interpretation: coalescing 防止 hot key stampede。

notes.quote: Idle eviction handles slow-burn growth: batch-map entries idle beyond a TTL are erased on the next flush. An in-flight cap handles acute overload.
notes.interpretation: batching 的兩道安全機制：idle eviction 與 in-flight cap。

notes.quote: Hot reads are served from an in-process cache; on a miss the gateway takes a per-key fill lock.
notes.interpretation: 讀取快取機制：in-process cache，miss 時用 per-key fill lock。

notes.quote: a change-data-capture stream of write and checkpoint events that invalidates or refills affected entries.
notes.interpretation: 快取靠 CDC 事件流做失效與重新填值。

notes.quote: Every request maps to a per-tenant bucket, keyed by use case and split by priority, and buckets drain round-robin.
notes.interpretation: Discriminant Load Shedding 的 bucket 機制。

notes.quote: In a controlled overload at >90% CPU across roughly 1,350 active tenant buckets, only 6 — the actual noisy neighbors — were shedding.
notes.interpretation: DLS 隔離效果的受控過載測試結果。

notes.quote: The balancer computes weights by reading each host's recent CPU utilization, normalizes the tier average to 1.0, and nudges each weight opposite to its load.
notes.interpretation: adaptive load balancing 的演算法。

notes.quote: Global routing builds a routing table spanning regions. Mega-regions group geographically close regions into one locality. Rings declare exactly which regions back each other up.
notes.interpretation: 跨區域失效的三層機制：global routing、mega-regions、rings。

notes.quote: about 40% of all ZippyDB traffic, projected to grow past 60%
notes.interpretation: 目前流量佔比 40% 為現況（asserted），超過 60% 為預測（projected，作者保留 hedge）。

notes.quote: only about 6% computational overhead to an average use case
notes.interpretation: ZGateway 對平均 use case 增加的計算成本。

notes.quote: greater than 1 billion operations per second
notes.interpretation: ZGateway 承載的尖峰吞吐規模。

notes.quote: near 97–98%, and the machinery cost about 8% of CPU
notes.interpretation: DLS 過載測試下 goodput 維持水準，以及機制本身的 CPU 成本。

notes.quote: The tradeoff is a hop and one more tier to operate.
notes.interpretation: 明確承認的代價：多一跳、多一層要維運。

notes.quote: is an OOM risk, so batching ships with two safety mechanisms.
notes.interpretation: batching 把 request 留在記憶體裡的 OOM 風險，促成兩道安全機制。

notes.quote: One tenant's memory blowup can threaten everything on the host
notes.interpretation: batcher 與 cache 共用 process 帶來的共享風險。

notes.quote: push part of the gateway down beside the ZServer host ... an extra network hop and a few percent of overhead
notes.interpretation: 規劃中、尚未上線的 co-location 方向，用來進一步壓低目前那一跳的開銷。
某台資料庫主機被摸到的機率公式，B 對應單一 client 平均要摸的 shard 数，H 為資料庫主機總数。

notes.quote: fan-in is that probability times the caller population
notes.interpretation: direct 模型下 fan-in = p × H_client。

notes.quote: fan-in reduces to approximately R · S_host, regions times shard density per host, independent of both fleets.
notes.interpretation: gateway 模型下 fan-in 公式，不含 client 数或 gateway 主機数。

notes.quote: The only lever left is shard density, which we own.
notes.interpretation: Meta 的重點主張：shard density 是他們唯一還能自己控制的變數。

notes.quote: 500,000 database hosts
notes.interpretation: ZServer 機隊規模，用於 fan-in 公式的 H。

notes.quote: 30,000 proxy hosts
notes.interpretation: ZGateway 機隊規模。

notes.quote: 1,000,000 clients
notes.interpretation: 目前 client 母體規模，用於 widget 的預設滑桿值與 gateway 固定參考線換算。

notes.quote: 50,000 shards per client
notes.interpretation: 單一 client 平均要摸的 shard 数，用於 fan-in 公式的 B。
受控過載測試中，1,350 個 bucket 扣掉 6 個被 shed 後、零被拒執行的 bucket 数。
